    371 +---
    372 +
    373 +## CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
    374 +
    375 +### Current State
    376 +
    377 +**CI/CD**: Not implemented (manual deployment)
    378 +
    379 +**Deployment**: Copy files to web server or GitHub Pages
    380 +
    381 +### Recommended CI/CD Setup (Future)
    382 +
    383 +**GitHub Actions Example**:
    384 +
    385 +```yaml
    386 +name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
    387 +
    388 +on:
    389 +  push:
    390 +    branches: [ main ]
    391 +
    392 +jobs:
    393 +  deploy:
    394 +    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    395 +    steps:
    396 +      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    397 +
    398 +      - name: Validate HTML
    399 +        run: |
    400 +          npm install -g htmlhint
    401 +          htmlhint index.html
    402 +
    403 +      - name: Validate CSS
    404 +        run: |
    405 +          npm install -g stylelint
    406 +          stylelint "**/*.css"
    407 +
    408 +      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
    409 +        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
    410 +        with:
    411 +          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    412 +          publish_dir: .
    413 +```
    414 +
    415 +**Benefits**:
    416 +
    417 +- Automated deployment on push
    418 +- Pre-deployment validation
    419 +- Zero manual steps
    420 +
    421 +---
    422 +
    423 +## Environment Management
    424 +
    425 +### Development Environment
    426 +
    427 +**Requirements**:
    428 +
    429 +- Modern web browser (Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge)
    430 +- Code editor (VS Code recommended)
    431 +- Local web server (optional but recommended)
    432 +
    433 +**Local Development Server Options**:
    434 +
    435 +1. **VS Code Live Server Extension**: One-click server
    436 +2. **Python**: `python -m http.server 8000`
    437 +3. **Node.js**: `npx http-server`
    438 +4. **PHP**: `php -S localhost:8000`
    439 +
    440 +**Why Local Server**:
    441 +
    442 +- Proper CORS handling
    443 +- Mimics production environment
    444 +- Hot reload capability
    445 +
    446 +### Staging Environment
    447 +
    448 +**Not Applicable**: No staging environment needed for static site
    449 +
    450 +**Testing Approach**: Test locally across browsers
    451 +
    452 +### Production Environment
    453 +
    454 +**Hosting Options**:
    455 +
    456 +1. **GitHub Pages**: Free, easy setup, custom domains
    457 +2. **Netlify**: Free tier, CDN included
    458 +3. **Vercel**: Free for personal projects
    459 +4. **Amazon S3 + CloudFront**: Scalable, professional
    460 +5. **Any static file hosting**: Apache, Nginx, etc.
    461 +
    462 +**Requirements**:
    463 +
    464 +- HTTP server capable of serving static files
    465 +- Support for custom error pages (optional)
    466 +- SSL/TLS certificate (recommended)
    467 +
    468 +**Configuration**:
    469 +
    470 +- No server-side configuration needed
    471 +- All files served as-is
    472 +- Optional: Set cache headers for theme files
    473 +
    474 +---
    475 +
    476 +## Deployment Architecture & Orchestration
    477 +
    478 +### Deployment Model
    479 +
    480 +**Architecture**: Static file hosting (JAMstack approach)
    481 +
    482 +**Components**:
    483 +
    484 +```
    485 +┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    486 +│         CDN / Web Server            │
    487 +│                                     │
    488 +│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │
    489 +│  │   Static Files                │ │
    490 +│  │   - index.html                │ │
    491 +│  │   - style.css                 │ │
    492 +│  │   - script.js                 │ │
    493 +│  │   - themes/*.css              │ │
    494 +│  │   - README.md                 │ │
    495 +│  │   - QUICK-REFERENCE.md        │ │
    496 +│  └───────────────────────────────┘ │
    497 +└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    498 +              │
    499 +              ▼
    500 +        ┌──────────┐
    501 +        │  Users   │
    502 +        └──────────┘
    503 +```
    504 +
    505 +**No Orchestration Needed**: Single-tier static deployment
    506 +
    507 +---
    508 +
    509 +## Observability Stack
    510 +
    511 +### Logging
    512 +
    513 +**Current**: Browser console logging only
    514 +
    515 +**Log Levels Used**:
    516 +
    517 +- `console.error()`: Critical failures
    518 +- `console.warn()`: Non-critical issues
    519 +- `console.log()`: Debugging (minimal in production)
    520 +
    521 +**Production Logging**: Errors visible in browser DevTools
    522 +
    523 +**No Server Logs**: Client-side only application
    524 +
    525 +### Metrics
    526 +
    527 +**Current**: No metrics collection
    528 +
    529 +**Future Options** (if needed):
    530 +
    531 +- Google Analytics (privacy concerns)
    532 +- Plausible Analytics (privacy-friendly)
    533 +- Self-hosted analytics (most privacy-preserving)
    534 +
    535 +**Key Metrics to Track**:
    536 +
    537 +- Page views
    538 +- Theme switches
    539 +- Export usage
    540 +- Error rates
    541 +- Performance timing
    542 +
    543 +### Tracing
    544 +
    545 +**Not Applicable**: Single-user, client-side application
    546 +
    547 +**Browser DevTools**: Built-in performance profiling
    548 +
    549 +### Alerting
    550 +
    551 +**Not Applicable**: No backend to monitor
    552 +
    553 +**Browser Error Monitoring Options** (if needed):
    554 +
    555 +- Sentry: Error tracking service
    556 +- LogRocket: Session replay
    557 +- Rollbar: Error monitoring
    558 +
    559 +---
    560 +
    561 +## Security Tools & Compliance
    562 +
    563 +### Security Measures
    564 +
    565 +**Client-Side Security**:
    566 +
    567 +1. **No Inline Scripts**: External JS file (CSP-friendly)
    568 +2. **Marked.js Sanitization**: Built-in HTML escaping
    569 +3. **No External Data**: No API calls to external services
    570 +4. **localStorage Only**: No cookies or external storage
    571 +
    572 +**Content Security Policy** (Recommended):
    573 +
    574 +```html
    575 +<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"
    576 +      content="default-src 'self';
    577 +               script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com;
    578 +               style-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com 'unsafe-inline';
    579 +               img-src 'self' data: https:;">
    580 +```
    581 +
    582 +### Dependency Security
    583 +
    584 +**Dependency Scanning**:
    585 +
    586 +- Manual review of CDN-loaded libraries
    587 +- Version pinning in HTML
    588 +- Periodic update checks
    589 +
    590 +**Known Vulnerabilities**: None in current versions
    591 +
    592 +**Update Strategy**:
    593 +
    594 +- Check for security advisories quarterly
    595 +- Test new versions before updating
    596 +- Document version changes
    597 +
    598 +### Compliance Requirements
    599 +
    600 +**GDPR Compliance**:
    601 +
    602 +- ✅ No personal data collection
    603 +- ✅ No tracking or analytics
    604 +- ✅ No cookies
    605 +- ✅ Local storage only (user's device)
    606 +- ✅ No data transmission
    607 +
    608 +**Accessibility Compliance**:
    609 +
    610 +- Target: WCAG 2.1 AA
    611 +- Color contrast ratios tested
    612 +- Keyboard navigation supported
    613 +- Semantic HTML structure
    614 +
    615 +---
    616 +
    617 +## Performance Profiling Tools
    618 +
    619 +### Browser DevTools
    620 +
    621 +**Chrome DevTools**:
    622 +
    623 +- **Performance Tab**: Record runtime performance
    624 +- **Network Tab**: Monitor resource loading
    625 +- **Lighthouse**: Automated audits
    626 +- **Memory Tab**: Profile memory usage
    627 +
    628 +**Key Metrics**:
    629 +
    630 +- First Contentful Paint (FCP): Target <1.5s
    631 +- Time to Interactive (TTI): Target <2s
    632 +- Total Blocking Time (TBT): Target <300ms
    633 +- Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Target <0.1
    634 +
    635 +### Lighthouse Scores
    636 +
    637 +**Target Scores**:
    638 +
    639 +- Performance: 90+
    640 +- Accessibility: 95+
    641 +- Best Practices: 95+
    642 +- SEO: 90+
    643 +
    644 +**Current Performance Characteristics**:
    645 +
    646 +- Initial Load: ~1.5s (including CDN resources)
    647 +- Markdown Render: <100ms typical
    648 +- Theme Switch: <50ms
    649 +- Export Generation: <500ms
    650 +
    651 +---
    652 +
    653 +## Library Versions & Migration Paths
    654 +
    655 +### Version Management
    656 +
    657 +**Current Versions**:
    658 +
    659 +- Marked.js: 11.0.0
    660 +- Prism.js: 1.29.0
    661 +- Mermaid.js: 10.6.1
    662 +
    663 +**Version Pinning Strategy**: Pin major versions, allow minor/patch updates
    664 +
    665 +**Update Process**:
    666 +
    667 +1. Review changelog for breaking changes
    668 +2. Update version in HTML
    669 +3. Test all functionality
    670 +4. Update memory bank documentation
    671 +5. Deploy to production
    672 +
    673 +### Migration Paths
    674 +
    675 +#### Marked.js Migration
    676 +
    677 +**Current**: v11.x
    678 +**Next Major**: v12.x (when released)
    679 +
    680 +**Breaking Changes to Watch**:
    681 +
    682 +- API changes in parsing options
    683 +- Renderer modifications
    684 +- Extension system changes
    685 +
    686 +**Migration Steps**:
    687 +
    688 +1. Review v12 migration guide
    689 +2. Update API calls if needed
    690 +3. Test all markdown features
    691 +4. Update documentation
    692 +
    693 +#### Prism.js Migration
    694 +
    695 +**Current**: v1.29.x
    696 +**Next Major**: v2.x (if released)
    697 +
    698 +**Stable API**: Prism has stable API, minimal breaking changes expected
    699 +
    700 +#### Mermaid.js Migration
    701 +
    702 +**Current**: v10.x
    703 +**Next Major**: v11.x (when released)
    704 +
    705 +**Breaking Changes to Watch**:
    706 +
    707 +- Configuration options
    708 +- Theme system changes
    709 +- Rendering API modifications
    710 +
    711 +---
    712 +
    713 +## Browser Compatibility Matrix
    714 +
    715 +### Minimum Supported Versions
    716 +
    717 +| Browser | Minimum Version | Current Version Tested |
    718 +|---------|----------------|----------------------|
    719 +| Chrome | 51 (ES6 support) | 119 |
    720 +| Firefox | 54 (ES6 support) | 119 |
    721 +| Safari | 10 (ES6 support) | 17 |
    722 +| Edge | 15 (ES6 support) | 119 |
    723 +
    724 +### Feature Support
    725 +
    726 +| Feature | Chrome | Firefox | Safari | Edge | Notes |
    727 +|---------|--------|---------|--------|------|-------|
    728 +| CSS Variables | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Core requirement |
    729 +| ES6 Syntax | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Core requirement |
    730 +| localStorage | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Core requirement |
    731 +| Fetch API | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | For export |
    732 +| Flexbox | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Layout |
    733 +| Grid | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Color picker layout |
    734 +
    735 +### Unsupported Browsers
    736 +
    737 +- ❌ Internet Explorer (all versions) - No ES6 support
    738 +- ❌ Opera Mini - Limited JavaScript support
    739 +- ❌ UC Browser - Inconsistent standards compliance
    740 +
    741 +---
    742 +
    743 +## Technology Decision Rationale
    744 +
    745 +### Why Vanilla JavaScript?
    746 +
    747 +1. **Zero Build Complexity**: No webpack, no babel, no config
    748 +2. **Maximum Portability**: Works anywhere with a browser
    749 +3. **Fast Load Times**: No framework overhead
    750 +4. **Long-term Stability**: Web standards don't break
    751 +5. **Learning Value**: Pure web platform APIs
    752 +
    753 +### Why CDN Dependencies?
    754 +
    755 +1. **No Build Step**: Direct browser loading
    756 +2. **Browser Caching**: Shared across sites
    757 +3. **Automatic Updates**: Can update versions easily
    758 +4. **Performance**: CDN edge locations
    759 +5. **Simplicity**: No npm, no package.json
    760 +
    761 +### Why CSS Custom Properties?
    762 +
    763 +1. **Runtime Theme Switching**: Change colors without reload
    764 +2. **Clean Separation**: Colors separate from structure
    765 +3. **Easy Customization**: Users can modify themes
    766 +4. **Performance**: Native browser feature
    767 +5. **Standard**: Widely supported
    768 +
    769 +### Why localStorage?
    770 +
    771 +1. **Simple API**: Synchronous, straightforward
    772 +2. **Sufficient Storage**: 5-10MB typical
    773 +3. **Universal Support**: All modern browsers
    774 +4. **Privacy**: Local-only, no transmission
    775 +5. **Perfect for Text**: Ideal for markdown content
    776 +
    777 +---
    778 +
    779 +## Future Technology Considerations
    780 +
    781 +### Potential Additions (Not Planned)
    782 +
    783 +**Service Worker**:
    784 +
    785 +- Offline capability after first load
    786 +- Cache static resources
    787 +- Background sync
    788 +
    789 +**Web Workers**:
    790 +
    791 +- Offload markdown parsing
    792 +- Large document handling
    793 +- Background processing
    794 +
    795 +**IndexedDB**:
    796 +
    797 +- Larger storage capacity
    798 +- Structured data queries
    799 +- Multiple document management
    800 +
    801 +**WebAssembly**:
    802 +
    803 +- Faster markdown parsing
    804 +- Advanced diagram rendering
    805 +- Performance optimization
    806 +
    807 +---
    808 +
    809 +## Conclusion
    810 +
    811 +Markdown Viewer Pro's technology stack represents a **deliberate minimalism** philosophy. By using vanilla web technologies with carefully selected libraries, the project achieves:
    812 +
    813 +1. **Maximum Simplicity**: No build tools, no complex config
    814 +2. **Broad Compatibility**: Works on all modern browsers
    815 +3. **Easy Maintenance**: Standard technologies, clear code
    816 +4. **Great Performance**: No framework overhead
    817 +5. **Long-term Stability**: Built on web standards
    818 +
    819 +This tech stack directly supports the product mission: instant, professional markdown editing without complexity or compromise.
    820

      1 +// Markdown Viewer Pro - Main Script

     11 +import Prism from 'prismjs';

     13 +// PrismJS is now handled by vite-plugin-prismjs

     16 +import { StorageManager } from './src/js/core/StorageManager.js';

     18 +import { FolderBrowserService } from './src/js/services/FolderBrowserService.js';
     19 +import { HTMLService } from './src/js/services/HTMLService.js';
     20 +import { MermaidService } from './src/js/services/MermaidService.js';

     22 +import { PrismService } from './src/js/services/PrismService.js';
     23 +
     24 +// Make libraries available globally for services if needed (backward compatibility)
     25 +window.marked = marked;

     32 +// ==================== ANCHOR NAVIGATION ====================
     33 +// Heading slug tracking (module-level singleton for marked.js singleton)
     34 +const headingSlugMap = new Map();
     35 +
     36 +// Pre-compiled slug replacements (zero GC pressure per render)
     37 +const SLUG_REPLACEMENTS = [
     38 +  [/c\+\+/gi, 'cpp'],
     39 +  [/c#/gi, 'csharp'],
     40 +  [/f#/gi, 'fsharp'],
     41 +  [/\.net/gi, 'dotnet'],
     42 +];
     43 +
     44 +/**
     45 + * Reset slug map (call before each parse)
     46 + */
     47 +function resetSlugMap() {
     48 +  headingSlugMap.clear();
     49 +}
     50 +
     51 +/**
     52 + * Generate URL-safe slug from heading text
     53 + * @param {string} text - Raw heading text (may include HTML)
     54 + * @param {Map<string, number>} seen - Duplicate tracking map
     55 + * @returns {string} URL-safe slug
     56 + */
     57 +function generateSlug(text, seen = headingSlugMap) {
     58 +  // Strip HTML tags
     59 +  let slug = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');
     60 +
     61 +  // Normalize Unicode
     62 +  slug = slug.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
     63 +
     64 +  // Replace programming terms (pre-compiled patterns)
     65 +  for (const [pattern, replacement] of SLUG_REPLACEMENTS) {
     66 +    slug = slug.replace(pattern, replacement);
     67 +  }
     68 +
     69 +  // Clean up: remove non-word chars, spaces to hyphens, collapse hyphens
     70 +  slug = slug
     71 +    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
     72 +    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
     73 +    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
     74 +    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
     75 +
     76 +  // Fallback for empty result
     77 +  if (!slug) slug = 'section';
     78 +
     79 +  // Handle duplicates (header, header-1, header-2)
     80 +  const baseSlug = slug;
     81 +  const count = seen.get(baseSlug) || 0;
     82 +  if (count > 0) slug = `${baseSlug}-${count}`;
     83 +  seen.set(baseSlug, count + 1);
     84 +
     85 +  return slug;
     86 +}

     88 +/**
     89 + * Anchor Navigation Module
     90 + * Handles in-document anchor navigation with scoped selection
     91 + */
     92 +const AnchorNavigation = {
     93 +  container: null,
     94 +  pendingScroll: null,
     95 +
     96 +  /**
     97 +   * Initialize anchor navigation
     98 +   * @param {HTMLElement} previewContainer - Scrollable preview container
     99 +   */
    100 +  init(previewContainer) {
    101 +    this.container = previewContainer;
    102 +
    103 +    // Event delegation for anchor clicks
    104 +    this.container.addEventListener('click', this.handleClick.bind(this));
    105 +
    106 +    // Browser back/forward navigation
    107 +    window.addEventListener('hashchange', this.handleHashChange.bind(this));
    108 +
    109 +    // Initial page load with hash
    110 +    if (window.location.hash) {
    111 +      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    112 +        this.scrollToHash(window.location.hash.slice(1), false);
    113 +      });
    114 +    }
    115 +
    116 +    console.log('✅ Anchor navigation initialized');
    117 +  },
    118 +
    119 +  /**
    120 +   * Handle click events (delegated)
    121 +   */
    122 +  handleClick(event) {
    123 +    const link = event.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
    124 +    if (!link) return;
    125 +
    126 +    // Ignore external links
    127 +    if (link.hostname && link.hostname !== window.location.hostname) return;
    128 +
    129 +    event.preventDefault();
    130 +
    131 +    const hash = link.getAttribute('href').slice(1);
    132 +    this.scrollToHash(hash, true);
    133 +
    134 +    // Update URL without triggering hashchange
    135 +    history.pushState(null, '', `#${hash}`);
    136 +  },
    137 +
    138 +  /**
    139 +   * Handle hashchange (browser back/forward)
    140 +   */
    141 +  handleHashChange() {
    142 +    const hash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
    143 +    if (hash) {
    144 +      this.scrollToHash(hash, true);
    145 +    } else {
    146 +      this.scrollToTop(true);
    147 +    }
    148 +  },
    149 +
    150 +  /**
    151 +   * Scroll to element by hash

    153 +   * @param {boolean} smooth - Use smooth scrolling
    154 +   */
    155 +  scrollToHash(hash, smooth = true) {
    156 +    // Cancel pending scroll (handle concurrent clicks)
    157 +    if (this.pendingScroll) {
    158 +      clearTimeout(this.pendingScroll);
    159 +      this.pendingScroll = null;
    160 +    }
    161 +
    162 +    if (!hash) {
    163 +      this.scrollToTop(smooth);
    164 +      return;
    165 +    }
    166 +
    167 +    const target = this.resolveTarget(hash);
    168 +    if (!target) return;

    170 +    target.scrollIntoView({
    171 +      behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'instant',
    172 +      block: 'start',
    173 +    });
    174 +
    175 +    this.manageFocus(target, smooth);
    176 +  },
    177 +
    178 +  /**
    179 +   * Scroll to top of container
    180 +   */
    181 +  scrollToTop(smooth = true) {
    182 +    this.container.scrollTo({
    183 +      top: 0,
    184 +      behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'instant',
    185 +    });
    186 +  },
    187 +
    188 +  /**
    189 +   * Resolve target element - SCOPED to container (prevents app shell collision)
    190 +   * @param {string} hash - URL hash
    191 +   * @returns {Element|null} Target element or null
    192 +   */
    193 +  resolveTarget(hash) {
    194 +    if (!hash) return null;
    195 +
    196 +    // Decode URI components safely
    197 +    let decodedHash;
    198 +    try {
    199 +      decodedHash = decodeURIComponent(hash);
    200 +    } catch {
    201 +      decodedHash = hash;
    202 +    }
    203 +
    204 +    // Priority 1: Exact ID (SCOPED to container)
    205 +    let target = this.container.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(decodedHash)}`);
    206 +    if (target) return target;
    207 +
    208 +    // Priority 2: Normalized ID with our custom replacements (C++ → cpp)
    209 +    const normalized = this.normalizeHash(decodedHash);
    210 +    target = this.container.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(normalized)}`);
    211 +    if (target) return target;
    212 +
    213 +    // Priority 3: GitHub-style normalization (C++ → c, keeps double hyphens)
    214 +    const githubStyle = this.normalizeHashGitHub(decodedHash);
    215 +    target = this.container.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(githubStyle)}`);
    216 +    if (target) return target;
    217 +
    218 +    // Priority 4: Try all headings for fuzzy match (last resort)
    219 +    const fuzzyTarget = this.fuzzyMatchHeading(decodedHash);
    220 +    if (fuzzyTarget) return fuzzyTarget;

    222 +    console.warn(`[AnchorNav] Target not found: "${hash}"`);
    223 +    return null;
    224 +  },
    225 +
    226 +  /**
    227 +   * Normalize hash with our custom replacements (C++ → cpp)
    228 +   * @param {string} hash - Raw hash string
    229 +   * @returns {string} Normalized hash
    230 +   */
    231 +  normalizeHash(hash) {
    232 +    let slug = hash.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
    233 +
    234 +    // Apply our custom transformations (C++ → cpp, etc.)
    235 +    for (const [pattern, replacement] of SLUG_REPLACEMENTS) {
    236 +      slug = slug.replace(pattern, replacement);
    237 +    }
    238 +
    239 +    return slug
    240 +      .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
    241 +      .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    242 +      .replace(/-+/g, '-')
    243 +      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'section';
    244 +  },
    245 +
    246 +  /**
    247 +   * GitHub-style normalization (more lenient, keeps structure)
    248 +   * @param {string} hash - Raw hash string
    249 +   * @returns {string} GitHub-style normalized hash
    250 +   */
    251 +  normalizeHashGitHub(hash) {
    252 +    // GitHub algorithm: lowercase, remove non-alphanumeric except hyphens
    253 +    // Does NOT collapse multiple hyphens, does NOT replace C++ with cpp
    254 +    return hash
    255 +      .normalize('NFC')
    256 +      .toLowerCase()
    257 +      .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
    258 +      .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    259 +      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'section';
    260 +  },
    261 +
    262 +  /**
    263 +   * Fuzzy match heading by text content similarity
    264 +   * @param {string} hash - Hash to find
    265 +   * @returns {Element|null} Matching heading or null
    266 +   */
    267 +  fuzzyMatchHeading(hash) {
    268 +    const headings = this.container.querySelectorAll('h1[id], h2[id], h3[id], h4[id], h5[id], h6[id]');
    269 +    const normalizedSearch = hash.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
    270 +
    271 +    for (const heading of headings) {
    272 +      const headingId = heading.id.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
    273 +      // Check if the search term is contained in the ID or vice versa
    274 +      if (headingId.includes(normalizedSearch) || normalizedSearch.includes(headingId)) {
    275 +        console.log(`[AnchorNav] Fuzzy matched "${hash}" → "${heading.id}"`);
    276 +        return heading;
    277 +      }
    278 +    }
    279 +    return null;
    280 +  },
    281 +
    282 +  /**
    283 +   * Manage focus after scroll (accessibility)
    284 +   * @param {Element} target - Target element
    285 +   * @param {boolean} smooth - Was smooth scroll used
    286 +   */
    287 +  manageFocus(target, smooth) {
    288 +    const focusTarget = () => {
    289 +      // Make heading focusable if not already
    290 +      if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
    291 +        target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    292 +      }
    293 +      target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    294 +    };
    295 +
    296 +    if (!smooth) {
    297 +      focusTarget();
    298 +      return;
    299 +    }
    300 +
    301 +    // Modern browsers: use scrollend event
    302 +    if ('onscrollend' in this.container) {
    303 +      this.container.addEventListener('scrollend', focusTarget, { once: true });
    304 +    } else {
    305 +      // Fallback: estimate scroll duration (max 1000ms for safety)
    306 +      const distance = Math.abs(target.getBoundingClientRect().top);
    307 +      const duration = Math.min(Math.max(distance / 2, 300), 1000);
    308 +      this.pendingScroll = setTimeout(focusTarget, duration + 50);
    309 +    }
    310 +  },
    311 +};

    362 +// ==================== SUPPORT MODAL (ONE-TIME POPUP) ====================
    363 +const SUPPORT_MODAL_SHOWN_KEY = 'support_modal_shown';
    364 +const SUPPORT_MODAL_DELAY_MS = 5000; // 5 seconds
    365 +
    366 +/**
    367 + * Initialize support modal - shows once after 5 seconds
    368 + */
    369 +function initSupportModal() {
    370 +  const modal = document.getElementById('support-modal');
    371 +  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-support-modal');
    372 +  const dontShowAgainCheckbox = document.getElementById('support-dont-show-again');
    373 +
    374 +  if (!modal || !closeBtn) {
    375 +    console.warn('[SupportModal] Modal elements not found');
    376 +    return;
    377 +  }
    378 +
    379 +  // Check if already shown before
    380 +  const alreadyShown = localStorage.getItem(SUPPORT_MODAL_SHOWN_KEY);
    381 +  if (alreadyShown === 'true') {
    382 +    console.log('[SupportModal] Already shown before, skipping');
    383 +    return;
    384 +  }
    385 +
    386 +  // Show modal after delay
    387 +  setTimeout(() => {
    388 +    modal.classList.add('active');
    389 +    console.log('[SupportModal] Showing support modal');
    390 +  }, SUPPORT_MODAL_DELAY_MS);
    391 +
    392 +  // Close button handler
    393 +  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    394 +    closeSupportModal(modal, dontShowAgainCheckbox);
    395 +  });
    396 +
    397 +  // Click outside to close
    398 +  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    399 +    if (e.target === modal) {
    400 +      closeSupportModal(modal, dontShowAgainCheckbox);
    401 +    }
    402 +  });
    403 +
    404 +  // Escape key to close
    405 +  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    406 +    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('active')) {
    407 +      closeSupportModal(modal, dontShowAgainCheckbox);
    408 +    }
    409 +  });
    410 +
    411 +  // Track clicks on support options
    412 +  modal.querySelectorAll('.support-option').forEach(option => {
    413 +    option.addEventListener('click', () => {
    414 +      // Mark as shown when user clicks a support option
    415 +      localStorage.setItem(SUPPORT_MODAL_SHOWN_KEY, 'true');
    416 +      console.log('[SupportModal] User clicked support option, marking as shown');
    417 +    });
    418 +  });
    419 +}
    420 +
    421 +/**
    422 + * Close the support modal
    423 + */
    424 +function closeSupportModal(modal, checkbox) {
    425 +  modal.classList.remove('active');
    426 +
    427 +  // If "Don't show again" is checked, remember it
    428 +  if (checkbox && checkbox.checked) {
    429 +    localStorage.setItem(SUPPORT_MODAL_SHOWN_KEY, 'true');
    430 +    console.log('[SupportModal] User opted out of future modals');
    431 +  }
    432 +}

    434 +// ==================== SUPPORT WIDGET (DONATION ROUTER) ====================
    435 +/**
    436 + * Enterprise-grade geo-based donation routing
    437 + * - 300ms timeout with fail-safe to global
    438 + * - Session caching to avoid repeated API calls
    439 + * - CLS mitigation via skeleton loader
    440 + */
    441 +const SUPPORT_TIMEOUT_MS = 300;
    442 +const SUPPORT_FALLBACK_REGION = 'global';
    443 +const SUPPORT_CACHE_KEY = 'support_user_region';
    444 +
    445 +/**
    446 + * Detect user region with fail-safe pattern
    447 + * @returns {Promise<string>} 'india' or 'global'
    448 + */
    449 +async function detectSupportRegion() {
    450 +  // 1. Check session cache first (FR-1.4)
    451 +  const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(SUPPORT_CACHE_KEY);
    452 +  if (cached) {
    453 +    console.log(`[SupportWidget] Using cached region: ${cached}`);
    454 +    return cached;
    455 +  }
    456 +
    457 +  try {
    458 +    // 2. Race: Network vs Timeout (300ms)
    459 +    const controller = new AbortController();
    460 +    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), SUPPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    461 +
    462 +    const response = await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    463 +      signal: controller.signal,
    464 +    });
    465 +    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    466 +
    467 +    const data = await response.json();
    468 +    const region = data.country_code === 'IN' ? 'india' : 'global';
    469 +
    470 +    // 3. Cache result for session
    471 +    sessionStorage.setItem(SUPPORT_CACHE_KEY, region);
    472 +    console.log(`[SupportWidget] Detected region: ${region} (${data.country_code})`);
    473 +    return region;
    474 +  } catch (error) {
    475 +    // 4. Fail open - silent fail to global
    476 +    console.warn('[SupportWidget] Geo-lookup failed/timed-out, defaulting to Global.', error.message);
    477 +    return SUPPORT_FALLBACK_REGION;
    478 +  }
    479 +}
    480 +
    481 +/**
    482 + * Toggle between India and Global support options
    483 + */
    484 +function toggleSupportRegion() {
    485 +  const currentRegion = sessionStorage.getItem(SUPPORT_CACHE_KEY) || SUPPORT_FALLBACK_REGION;
    486 +  const newRegion = currentRegion === 'india' ? 'global' : 'india';
    487 +  sessionStorage.setItem(SUPPORT_CACHE_KEY, newRegion);
    488 +  renderSupportWidget(newRegion);
    489 +  console.log(`[SupportWidget] Toggled region: ${currentRegion} → ${newRegion}`);
    490 +}
    491 +
    492 +// Make toggle function globally accessible for onclick
    493 +window.toggleSupportRegion = toggleSupportRegion;
    494 +
    495 +/**
    496 + * Render support widget based on region
    497 + * @param {string} region - 'india' or 'global'
    498 + */
    499 +function renderSupportWidget(region) {
    500 +  const container = document.getElementById('support-widget');
    501 +  if (!container) return;
    502 +
    503 +  const config = region === 'india'
    504 +    ? {
    505 +      text: '🇮🇳 Support via UPI',
    506 +      url: 'https://razorpay.me/@prakharshekharparthasarthi?notes[source]=webapp_footer',
    507 +      className: 'support-button--india',
    508 +      toggleText: 'Not in India?',
    509 +    }
    510 +    : {
    511 +      text: '☕ Support via Ko-fi',
    512 +      url: 'https://ko-fi.com/praxlannister?ref=webapp_footer',
    513 +      className: 'support-button--global',
    514 +      toggleText: 'In India? Use UPI',
    515 +    };
    516 +
    517 +  container.innerHTML = `
    518 +    <a href="${config.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="support-button ${config.className}">
    519 +      ${config.text}
    520 +    </a>
    521 +    <button class="support-toggle" onclick="toggleSupportRegion()">${config.toggleText}</button>
    522 +  `;
    523 +}

    525 +/**

    528 +async function initSupportWidget() {

    545 +/**
    546 + * Debounce utility function
    547 + * @param {Function} func - Function to debounce
    548 + * @param {number} wait - Wait time in milliseconds
    549 + * @returns {Function} Debounced function
    550 + */
    551 +function debounce(func, wait) {
    552 +  let timeout;
    553 +  return function truncated(...args) {
    554 +    clearTimeout(timeout);
    555 +    timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    556 +      func.apply(this, args);
    557 +    }, wait);
    558 +  };
    559 +}
    560 +
    561 +// Configure marked.js extensions (math + footnotes + admonitions)
    562 +function configureMarkedExtensions() {
    563 +  // Enable footnote support
    564 +  marked.use(markedFootnote());
    565 +  console.log('✅ Footnotes enabled');
    566 +
    567 +  // Add GitHub-style admonitions
    568 +  marked.use({
    569 +    extensions: [
    570 +      {
    571 +        name: 'admonition',
    572 +        level: 'block',
    573 +        start(src) {
    574 +          return src.match(/^> \[!/)?.index;
    575 +        },
    576 +        tokenizer(src) {
    577 +          const match = src.match(
    578 +            /^> \[!(NOTE|TIP|IMPORTANT|WARNING|CAUTION)\]\s*\n((?:> .*\n?)*)/,
    579 +          );
    580 +          if (match) {
    581 +            const type = match[1];
    582 +            const content = match[2].replace(/^> ?/gm, '').trim();
    583 +            return {
    584 +              type: 'admonition',
    585 +              raw: match[0],
    586 +              admonitionType: type,
    587 +              text: content,
    588 +            };
    589 +          }
    590 +        },
    591 +        renderer(token) {
    592 +          const icons = {
    593 +            NOTE: 'ℹ️',
    594 +            TIP: '💡',
    595 +            IMPORTANT: '❗',
    596 +            WARNING: '⚠️',
    597 +            CAUTION: '🚨',
    598 +          };
    599 +          const icon = icons[token.admonitionType] || 'ℹ️';
    600 +          const typeClass = token.admonitionType.toLowerCase();
    601 +
    602 +          return `<div class="admonition admonition-${typeClass}">
    603 +            <div class="admonition-title">
    604 +              <span class="admonition-icon">${icon}</span>
    605 +              <strong>${token.admonitionType}</strong>
    606 +            </div>
    607 +            <div class="admonition-content">${marked.parseInline(token.text)}</div>
    608 +          </div>`;
    609 +        },
    610 +      },
    611 +    ],
    612 +  });
    613 +  console.log('✅ GitHub admonitions enabled');
    614 +
    615 +  // Configure math formulas (KaTeX is now imported at top level)
    616 +
    617 +  // Add inline math and text formatting extensions only
    618 +  // LaTeX environments (align, gather, etc.) are not supported by KaTeX
    619 +  marked.use({
    620 +    extensions: [
    621 +      {
    622 +        name: 'mathBlock',
    623 +        level: 'block',
    624 +        start(src) {
    625 +          return src.match(/^\$\$|\\\[/)?.index;
    626 +        },
    627 +        tokenizer(src) {
    628 +          const doubleDollar = src.match(/^\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$/);
    629 +          if (doubleDollar) {
    630 +            return {
    631 +              type: 'mathBlock',
    632 +              raw: doubleDollar[0],
    633 +              text: doubleDollar[1].trim(),
    634 +            };
    635 +          }
    636 +
    637 +          const bracket = src.match(/^\\\[([\s\S]+?)\\\]/);
    638 +          if (bracket) {
    639 +            return {
    640 +              type: 'mathBlock',
    641 +              raw: bracket[0],
    642 +              text: bracket[1].trim(),
    643 +            };
    644 +          }
    645 +        },
    646 +        renderer(token) {
    647 +          try {
    648 +            return (
    649 +              `<div style="margin: 1.5em 0;">${katex.renderToString(token.text, {
    650 +                displayMode: true,
    651 +                throwOnError: false,
    652 +                output: 'html',
    653 +                trust: true, // Allow custom styling
    654 +                macros: {
    655 +                  '\\label': '\\phantom', // Hide \label
    656 +                },
    657 +              })
    658 +              }</div>`
    659 +            );
    660 +          } catch (e) {
    661 +            console.warn('KaTeX display math error:', e);
    662 +            return `<div style="color: red; padding: 10px;">Math Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    663 +          }
    664 +        },
    665 +      },
    666 +      {
    667 +        name: 'mathEnvironment',
    668 +        level: 'block',
    669 +        start(src) {
    670 +          // Allow whitespace before \begin
    671 +          return src.match(/^\s*\\begin/)?.index;
    672 +        },
    673 +        tokenizer(src) {
    674 +          // Robust regex for LaTeX environments (tolerant to whitespace)
    675 +          // Capture group 1: Full content, Group 2: Env Name, Group 3: Inner Content
    676 +          const match = src.match(/^\s*(\\begin\s*\{([a-zA-Z]+\*?)\}([\s\S]*?)\\end\s*\{\2\})/);
    677 +          if (match) {
    678 +            let text = match[1];
    679 +            const env = match[2];
    680 +            // Shim 'multline' (not supported by KaTeX core) to 'gathered'
    681 +            if (env === 'multline' || env === 'multline*') {
    682 +              console.warn('Shimming multline to gathered for KaTeX compatibility');
    683 +              text = `\\begin{gathered}${match[3]}\\end{gathered}`;
    684 +            }
    685 +
    686 +            return {
    687 +              type: 'mathEnvironment',
    688 +              raw: match[0],
    689 +              text,
    690 +            };
    691 +          }
    692 +        },
    693 +        renderer(token) {
    694 +          try {
    695 +            return (
    696 +              `<div style="margin: 1.5em 0;">${katex.renderToString(token.text, {
    697 +                displayMode: true,
    698 +                throwOnError: false,
    699 +                output: 'html',
    700 +                trust: true,
    701 +                macros: {
    702 +                  '\\label': '\\phantom', // Hide \label
    703 +                  '\\eqref': '\\text', // Plain text for refs (or link if needed)
    704 +                  '\\cite': '\\text',
    705 +                  '\\ref': '\\text',
    706 +                },
    707 +              })
    708 +              }</div>`
    709 +            );
    710 +          } catch (e) {
    711 +            console.warn('KaTeX environment error:', e);
    712 +            return `<div style="color: red;">LaTeX Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    713 +          }
    714 +        },
    715 +      },
    716 +      {
    717 +        name: 'mathInline',
    718 +        level: 'inline',
    719 +        start(src) {
    720 +          return src.match(/\$|\\\(/)?.index;
    721 +        },
    722 +        tokenizer(src) {
    723 +          // Try display math first ($$...$$)
    724 +          const displayMatch = src.match(/^\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$/);
    725 +          if (displayMatch) {
    726 +            return {
    727 +              type: 'mathInline',
    728 +              raw: displayMatch[0],
    729 +              text: displayMatch[1].trim(),
    730 +              displayMode: true,
    731 +            };
    732 +          }
    733 +
    734 +          // Try LaTeX display math (\[...\]) - should be handled by block, but just in case
    735 +          const bracketMatch = src.match(/^\\\[([\s\S]+?)\\\]/);
    736 +          if (bracketMatch) {
    737 +            return {
    738 +              type: 'mathInline',
    739 +              raw: bracketMatch[0],
    740 +              text: bracketMatch[1].trim(),
    741 +              displayMode: true,
    742 +            };
    743 +          }
    744 +
    745 +          // Try LaTeX inline math (\(...\))
    746 +          const parenMatch = src.match(/^\\\(([\s\S]+?)\\\)/);
    747 +          if (parenMatch) {
    748 +            return {
    749 +              type: 'mathInline',
    750 +              raw: parenMatch[0],
    751 +              text: parenMatch[1].trim(),
    752 +              displayMode: false,
    753 +            };
    754 +          }
    755 +
    756 +          // Then try inline math ($...$)
    757 +          const inlineMatch = src.match(/^\$([^$\n]+?)\$/);
    758 +          if (inlineMatch) {
    759 +            return {
    760 +              type: 'mathInline',
    761 +              raw: inlineMatch[0],
    762 +              text: inlineMatch[1].trim(),
    763 +              displayMode: false,
    764 +            };
    765 +          }
    766 +        },
    767 +        renderer(token) {
    768 +          try {
    769 +            const rendered = katex.renderToString(token.text, {
    770 +              displayMode: token.displayMode || false,
    771 +              throwOnError: false,
    772 +              output: 'html',
    773 +              macros: {
    774 +                '\\label': '\\phantom',
    775 +              },
    776 +            });
    777 +
    778 +            // Wrap display math in a div for proper spacing
    779 +            if (token.displayMode) {
    780 +              return `<div style="margin: 1.5em 0;">${rendered}</div>`;
    781 +            }
    782 +            return rendered;
    783 +          } catch (e) {
    784 +            console.warn('KaTeX math error:', e);
    785 +            return `<span style="color: red;">Math Error</span>`;
    786 +          }
    787 +        },
    788 +      },
    789 +      {
    790 +        name: 'subscript',
    791 +        level: 'inline',
    792 +        start(src) {
    793 +          return src.match(/~/)?.index;
    794 +        },
    795 +        tokenizer(src) {
    796 +          const match = src.match(/^~([^~\s]+)~/);
    797 +          if (match) {
    798 +            return {
    799 +              type: 'subscript',
    800 +              raw: match[0],
    801 +              text: match[1],
    802 +            };
    803 +          }
    804 +        },
    805 +        renderer(token) {
    806 +          return `<sub>${token.text}</sub>`;
    807 +        },
    808 +      },
    809 +      {
    810 +        name: 'superscript',
    811 +        level: 'inline',
    812 +        start(src) {
    813 +          return src.match(/\^/)?.index;
    814 +        },
    815 +        tokenizer(src) {
    816 +          const match = src.match(/^\^([^^\s]+)\^/);
    817 +          if (match) {
    818 +            return {
    819 +              type: 'superscript',
    820 +              raw: match[0],
    821 +              text: match[1],
    822 +            };
    823 +          }
    824 +        },
    825 +        renderer(token) {
    826 +          return `<sup>${token.text}</sup>`;
    827 +        },
    828 +      },
    829 +    ],
    830 +  });

    1362 +  // Apply split ratio to containers
    1363 +  function applySplitRatio() {
    1364 +    if (!mainContent.classList.contains('split-view-active')) { return; }
    1365 +
    1366 +    const mainContentWidth = mainContent.offsetWidth;
    1367 +    const sidebarWidth = document.getElementById('file-browser').offsetWidth || 0;
    1368 +    const availableWidth = mainContentWidth - sidebarWidth - 8; // 8px for resizer
    1369 +
    1370 +    const editorWidth = availableWidth * splitRatio;
    1371 +    const previewWidth = availableWidth * (1 - splitRatio);
    1372 +
    1373 +    editorContainer.style.flex = 'none';
    1374 +    editorContainer.style.width = `${editorWidth}px`;
    1375 +    previewContainer.style.flex = 'none';
    1376 +    previewContainer.style.width = `${previewWidth}px`;
    1377 +  }
    1378 +
    1379 +  // Reset to flex layout (equal split)

    1408 +    // Calculate new ratio based on mouse position

    1531 +      } else if (editor.scrollTop >= editorHeight) {
    1532 +        // At bottom
    1533 +        previewContainer.scrollTop = previewHeight;
    1534 +      } else {
    1535 +        // Middle - proportional scroll

     18 +  PERMISSION_DENIED_SAVE: 'Write permission denied. Cannot save file.',
     19 +

     22 +  INVALID_FILENAME_PROVIDED: 'Invalid filename provided.',
     23 +  FILE_EXISTS: (filename) => `File "${filename}" already exists. Please choose a different name.`,
     24 +  FILE_CREATE_FAILED: 'Failed to create file.',
     25 +  FILE_SAVE_FAILED: 'Failed to save file.',
     26 +  NO_FILE_HANDLE: 'No file handle provided.',
     27 +
     28 +  // Directory Operations
     29 +  INVALID_DIRECTORY_NAME: 'Invalid directory name.',
     30 +

     34 +};
     35 +
     36 +/**
     37 + * Get error message with optional parameter substitution
     38 + *
     39 + * @param {string|Function} message - Error message string or function
     40 + * @param {any} params - Parameters for function-based messages
     41 + * @returns {string} Final error message
     42 + */
     43 +export function getErrorMessage(message, ...params) {
     44 +  if (typeof message === 'function') {
     45 +    return message(...params);
     46 +  }
     47 +  return message;
     48 +}

      1 +/**
      2 + * Feature Flags Configuration
      3 + *
      4 + * Controls which code paths are active (old vs new).
      5 + * Provides instant rollback capability during refactoring.
      6 + *
      7 + * SAFETY: Set to false to use old code, true to use new modules.
      8 + */
      9 +
     10 +/**
     11 + * @typedef {Object} FeatureFlags
     12 + * @property {boolean} USE_STORAGE_MANAGER - Use StorageManager class
     13 + * @property {boolean} USE_THEME_MANAGER - Use ThemeManager class
     14 + * @property {boolean} USE_MERMAID_SERVICE - Use MermaidService class
     15 + * @property {boolean} USE_PRISM_SERVICE - Use PrismService class
     16 + * @property {boolean} USE_UTILS - Use utility helper functions
     17 + */
     18 +
     19 +/**
     20 + * Feature flags for gradual module rollout
     21 + *
     22 + * Start with ALL flags set to FALSE.
     23 + * Enable one at a time after testing.
     24 + *
     25 + * @type {FeatureFlags}
     26 + */
     27 +export const FEATURE_FLAGS = {
     28 +  // Core Modules - Week 5
     29 +  USE_STORAGE_MANAGER: false, // StorageManager for localStorage
     30 +  USE_THEME_MANAGER: false, // ThemeManager for themes
     31 +
     32 +  // Services - Week 4
     33 +  USE_MERMAID_SERVICE: false, // MermaidService for diagrams
     34 +  USE_PRISM_SERVICE: false, // PrismService for highlighting
     35 +
     36 +  // Utilities - Week 3
     37 +  USE_UTILS: false, // Utility functions (htmlHelpers, colorHelpers)
     38 +
     39 +  // Safety Features
     40 +  ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGGING: false, // Extra console logs for debugging
     41 +  ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_MONITORING: false, // Track performance metrics
     42 +};
     43 +
     44 +/**
     45 + * Check if new code should be used
     46 + *
     47 + * @param {string} flagName - Name of feature flag
     48 + * @returns {boolean} True if flag is enabled
     49 + *
     50 + * @example
     51 + * if (isFeatureEnabled('USE_THEME_MANAGER')) {
     52 + *   // Use new ThemeManager
     53 + * } else {
     54 + *   // Use old code
     55 + * }
     56 + */
     57 +export function isFeatureEnabled(flagName) {
     58 +  return FEATURE_FLAGS[flagName] === true;
     59 +}
     60 +
     61 +/**
     62 + * Enable a feature flag
     63 + * USE WITH CAUTION
     64 + *
     65 + * @param {string} flagName - Flag to enable
     66 + */
     67 +export function enableFeature(flagName) {
     68 +  if (Object.hasOwn(FEATURE_FLAGS, flagName)) {
     69 +    FEATURE_FLAGS[flagName] = true;
     70 +    console.log(`✅ Feature enabled: ${flagName}`);
     71 +  } else {
     72 +    console.warn(`⚠️ Unknown feature flag: ${flagName}`);
     73 +  }
     74 +}
     75 +
     76 +/**
     77 + * Disable a feature flag (rollback)
     78 + *
     79 + * @param {string} flagName - Flag to disable
     80 + */
     81 +export function disableFeature(flagName) {
     82 +  if (Object.hasOwn(FEATURE_FLAGS, flagName)) {
     83 +    FEATURE_FLAGS[flagName] = false;
     84 +    console.log(`🔄 Feature disabled: ${flagName}`);
     85 +  } else {
     86 +    console.warn(`⚠️ Unknown feature flag: ${flagName}`);
     87 +  }
     88 +}
     89 +
     90 +/**
     91 + * Get status of all feature flags
     92 + *
     93 + * @returns {FeatureFlags} Current flag states
     94 + */
     95 +export function getAllFlags() {
     96 +  return { ...FEATURE_FLAGS };
     97 +}

      1 +/**
      2 + * StorageManager - LocalStorage Abstraction Layer
      3 + *
      4 + * Provides a clean interface for localStorage operations with error handling.
      5 + * Centralizes all data persistence logic for better testability.
      6 + */
      7 +
      8 +/**
      9 + * @class StorageManager
     10 + * @description Manages all localStorage operations with error handling
     11 + *
     12 + * @example
     13 + * const storage = new StorageManager();
     14 + * storage.set(STORAGE_KEYS.MARKDOWN_CONTENT, 'Hello World');
     15 + * const content = storage.get(STORAGE_KEYS.MARKDOWN_CONTENT);
     16 + */
     17 +export class StorageManager {
     18 +  constructor() {
     19 +    this.CURRENT_VERSION = 2;
     20 +    this.VERSION_KEY = '__storage_version';
     21 +  }
     22 +
     23 +  /**
     24 +   * Get item from localStorage
     25 +   *
     26 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
     27 +   * @returns {string|null} Stored value or null if not found
     28 +   *
     29 +   * @example
     30 +   * const theme = storage.get(STORAGE_KEYS.SELECTED_THEME);
     31 +   */
     32 +  get(key) {
     33 +    try {
     34 +      return localStorage.getItem(key);
     35 +    } catch (error) {
     36 +      console.error('Storage get error:', error);
     37 +      return null;
     38 +    }
     39 +  }
     40 +
     41 +  /**
     42 +   * Set item in localStorage
     43 +   *
     44 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
     45 +   * @param {string} value - Value to store
     46 +   * @returns {boolean} True if successful
     47 +   *
     48 +   * @example
     49 +   * storage.set(STORAGE_KEYS.SELECTED_THEME, 'ocean-dark');
     50 +   */
     51 +  set(key, value) {
     52 +    try {
     53 +      localStorage.setItem(key, value);
     54 +      return true;
     55 +    } catch (error) {
     56 +      console.error('Storage set error:', error);
     57 +      return false;
     58 +    }
     59 +  }
     60 +
     61 +  /**
     62 +   * Remove item from localStorage
     63 +   *
     64 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
     65 +   * @returns {boolean} True if successful
     66 +   *
     67 +   * @example
     68 +   * storage.remove(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_THEME);
     69 +   */
     70 +  remove(key) {
     71 +    try {
     72 +      localStorage.removeItem(key);
     73 +      return true;
     74 +    } catch (error) {
     75 +      console.error('Storage remove error:', error);
     76 +      return false;
     77 +    }
     78 +  }
     79 +
     80 +  /**
     81 +   * Check if key exists in storage
     82 +   *
     83 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
     84 +   * @returns {boolean} True if key exists
     85 +   *
     86 +   * @example
     87 +   * if (storage.has(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_THEME)) { }
     88 +   */
     89 +  has(key) {
     90 +    return this.get(key) !== null;
     91 +  }
     92 +
     93 +  /**
     94 +   * Get JSON object from storage
     95 +   *
     96 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
     97 +   * @returns {any|null} Parsed JSON or null if not found/invalid
     98 +   *
     99 +   * @example
    100 +   * const theme = storage.getJSON(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_THEME);
    101 +   */
    102 +  getJSON(key) {
    103 +    const value = this.get(key);
    104 +    if (!value) {
    105 +      return null;
    106 +    }
    107 +
    108 +    try {
    109 +      return JSON.parse(value);
    110 +    } catch (error) {
    111 +      console.error('JSON parse error:', error);
    112 +      return null;
    113 +    }
    114 +  }
    115 +
    116 +  /**
    117 +   * Set JSON object in storage
    118 +   *
    119 +   * @param {string} key - Storage key
    120 +   * @param {any} value - Value to stringify and store
    121 +   * @returns {boolean} True if successful
    122 +   *
    123 +   * @example
    124 +   * storage.setJSON(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_THEME, { '--h1-color': '#ff0000' });
    125 +   */
    126 +  setJSON(key, value) {
    127 +    try {
    128 +      const json = JSON.stringify(value);
    129 +      return this.set(key, json);
    130 +    } catch (error) {
    131 +      console.error('JSON stringify error:', error);
    132 +      return false;
    133 +    }
    134 +  }
    135 +
    136 +  /**
    137 +   * Clear all items from storage
    138 +   * USE WITH CAUTION
    139 +   *
    140 +   * @returns {boolean} True if successful
    141 +   */
    142 +  clear() {
    143 +    try {
    144 +      localStorage.clear();
    145 +      return true;
    146 +    } catch (error) {
    147 +      console.error('Storage clear error:', error);
    148 +      return false;
    149 +    }
    150 +  }
    151 +
    152 +  /**
    153 +   * Get all keys in storage
    154 +   *
    155 +   * @returns {string[]} Array of storage keys
    156 +   */
    157 +  getAllKeys() {
    158 +    try {
    159 +      return Object.keys(localStorage);
    160 +    } catch (error) {
    161 +      console.error('Storage getAllKeys error:', error);
    162 +      return [];
    163 +    }
    164 +  }
    165 +
    166 +  /**
    167 +   * Get storage size in bytes (approximate)
    168 +   *
    169 +   * @returns {number} Approximate size in bytes
    170 +   */
    171 +  getSize() {
    172 +    try {
    173 +      let total = 0;
    174 +      for (const key in localStorage) {
    175 +        if (Object.hasOwn(localStorage, key)) {
    176 +          const value = localStorage.getItem(key);
    177 +          total += key.length + (value?.length || 0);
    178 +        }
    179 +      }
    180 +      return total;
    181 +    } catch (error) {
    182 +      console.error('Storage getSize error:', error);
    183 +      return 0;
    184 +    }
    185 +  }
    186 +
    187 +  /**
    188 +   * Check if storage is available
    189 +   *
    190 +   * @returns {boolean} True if localStorage is available
    191 +   */
    192 +  isAvailable() {
    193 +    try {
    194 +      const test = '__storage_test__';
    195 +      localStorage.setItem(test, test);
    196 +      localStorage.removeItem(test);
    197 +      return true;
    198 +    } catch {
    199 +      return false;
    200 +    }
    201 +  }
    202 +}
    203

      1 +/**
      2 + * ThemeManager - Theme Management Core Module
      3 + *
      4 + * Handles all theme operations: loading, switching, customization, and persistence.
      5 + * Integrates with StorageManager for persistence and MermaidService for theme updates.
      6 + */
      7 +
      8 +import { ELEMENT_IDS, STORAGE_KEYS, THEMES } from '../config/constants.js';
      9 +import { getCssVariable, removeCssVariable, setCssVariable } from '../utils/colorHelpers.js';
     10 +import { isValidTheme } from '../utils/validators.js';
     11 +
     12 +/**
     13 + * @class ThemeManager
     14 + * @description Manages theme loading, switching, and customization
     15 + *
     16 + * @example
     17 + * const storage = new StorageManager();
     18 + * const themeManager = new ThemeManager(storage);
     19 + * await themeManager.loadTheme('ocean-dark');
     20 + */
     21 +export class ThemeManager {
     22 +  /**
     23 +   * @param {StorageManager} storageManager - Storage manager instance
     24 +   */
     25 +  constructor(storageManager) {
     26 +    this.storage = storageManager;
     27 +    this.currentTheme = null;
     28 +    this.onThemeChange = null;
     29 +  }
     30 +
     31 +  /**
     32 +   * Load and apply a theme
     33 +   *
     34 +   * @param {string} themeName - Name of theme to load
     35 +   * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if successful
     36 +   * @throws {Error} If theme name is invalid
     37 +   *
     38 +   * @example
     39 +   * await themeManager.loadTheme('obsidian-dark');
     40 +   */
     41 +  async loadTheme(themeName) {
     42 +    // Validate theme name
     43 +    if (!isValidTheme(themeName)) {
     44 +      throw new Error(`Invalid theme: ${themeName}`);
     45 +    }
     46 +
     47 +    // Load appropriate theme
     48 +    if (themeName === THEMES.CUSTOM) {
     49 +      return this.loadCustomTheme();
     50 +    }
     51 +
     52 +    return this.loadBuiltInTheme(themeName);
     53 +  }
     54 +
     55 +  /**
     56 +   * Load a built-in theme from CSS file
     57 +   *
     58 +   * @param {string} themeName - Built-in theme name

    532 +  async saveFile(fileHandle, content) {

    638 +  sanitizeFilename(filename) {
    639 +    const MAX_LENGTH = 200; // Safe limit for most filesystems
    640 +    const WINDOWS_RESERVED = /^(con|prn|aux|nul|com[1-9]|lpt[1-9])$/i;
    641 +    const INVALID_CHARS = '<>:"/\\|?*';
    642 +
    643 +    // Remove dangerous characters including control chars (0-31)
    644 +    let sanitized = filename
    645 +      .split('')
    646 +      .filter(char => {
    647 +        const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
    648 +        return code >= 32 && !INVALID_CHARS.includes(char);
    649 +      })
    650 +      .join('')
    651 +      .replace(/^\.+/, '') // Remove leading dots
    652 +      .replace(/\.+$/, '') // Remove trailing dots (except extension)
    653 +      .replace(/\s+$/, '') // Remove trailing spaces
    654 +      .trim();
    655 +
    656 +    // Handle Windows reserved names
    657 +    const baseName = sanitized.replace(/\..*$/, '');
    658 +    if (WINDOWS_RESERVED.test(baseName)) {
    659 +      sanitized = `_${sanitized}`;
    660 +    }
    661 +
    662 +    // Truncate to safe length
    663 +    return sanitized.slice(0, MAX_LENGTH);

    666 +  /**

    672 +  async getDirectoryByPath(path) {
    673 +    if (!this.currentDirectoryHandle || !path) {
    674 +      return this.currentDirectoryHandle;
    675 +    }
    676 +
    677 +    try {

    679 +      const parts = path.split('/').filter(p => p && p !== '');
    680 +
    681 +      for (const part of parts) {

    683 +      }
    684 +

    724 +        if (permissionStatus !== 'granted') {
    725 +          return {
    726 +            success: false,
    727 +            error: 'Write permission denied.',
    728 +          };
    729 +        }
    730 +      }
    731 +
    732 +      const directoryHandle = await targetDir.getDirectoryHandle(sanitizedName, { create: true });
    733 +
    734 +      console.log(`✅ Created directory: ${sanitizedName}`);

    101 +  /**
    102 +   * Helper to retrieve CSS content

    105 +  async getThemeCSS(themeName, customTheme) {
    106 +    if (themeName === 'custom' && customTheme) {
    107 +      let css = ':root {\n';
    108 +      Object.entries(customTheme).forEach(([prop, val]) => {
    109 +        css += `    ${prop}: ${val};\n`;
    110 +      });
    111 +      css += '}';
    112 +      return css;
    113 +    }
    114 +    const baseUrl = import.meta.env.BASE_URL || '/';
    115 +    // Remove leading slash from baseUrl if present to avoid double slash with themes/
    116 +    // Actually relative fetch is best.
    117 +
    118 +    try {
    119 +      // Fetch both the specific theme and the global variables which define the tokens
    120 +      const requestPromises = [
    121 +        fetch(`${baseUrl}themes/${themeName}.css`),
    122 +        fetch(`${baseUrl}variables.css`),
    123 +      ];
    124 +
    125 +      // If Nebula theme, also fetch the micro-elements styles
    126 +      if (themeName.startsWith('nebula-')) {
    127 +        requestPromises.push(fetch(`${baseUrl}themes/nebula-elements.css`));
    128 +      }
    129 +
    130 +      const responses = await Promise.all(requestPromises);
    131 +      const themeRes = responses[0];
    132 +      const variablesRes = responses[1];
    133 +      const nebulaElementsRes = responses[2]; // Undefined if not nebula
    134 +
    135 +      if (!themeRes.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to load theme: ${themeRes.statusText}`); }
    136 +
    137 +      let cssContent = '';
    138 +
    139 +      // Process variables.css
    140 +      if (variablesRes.ok) {
    141 +        const variablesText = await variablesRes.text();
    142 +        cssContent += `${this.extractCSS(variablesText, baseUrl)}\n`;
    143 +      } else {
    144 +        console.warn('variables.css could not be loaded for export');
    145 +      }
    146 +
    147 +      // Process Nebula Elements if present
    148 +      if (nebulaElementsRes && nebulaElementsRes.ok) {
    149 +        const nebulaText = await nebulaElementsRes.text();
    150 +        cssContent += `${this.extractCSS(nebulaText, baseUrl)}\n`;
    151 +      }
    152 +
    153 +      // Process Theme CSS
    154 +      const themeText = await themeRes.text();
    155 +      cssContent += this.extractCSS(themeText, baseUrl);
    156 +
    157 +      return cssContent;
    158 +    } catch (error) {
    159 +      console.warn('Error loading theme CSS:', error);
    160 +      // Fallback: minimal styling
    161 +      return `
    162 +        body { background-color: #fff; color: #333; }
    163 +        code { background-color: #f5f5f5; }
    164 +        pre { background-color: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #ddd; }
    165 +        blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #ddd; color: #666; }

    172 +  /**
    173 +   * Helper to extract CSS from potential Vite module wrapper or raw text
    174 +   */
    175 +  extractCSS(text, _baseUrl) {
    176 +    // Vite dev server serves CSS files as JS modules (import ...)
    177 +    // We need to extract the actual CSS string.
    178 +    // Typical format: "import ... \n const css = \"...\" ... export default css"
    179 +    // OR direct CSS in production build.
    180 +
    181 +    // Simple check for Vite JS module wrapper
    182 +    if (text.includes('export default') || text.includes('const css =')) {
    183 +      const match = text.match(/const\s+css\s*=\s*"([\s\S]*?)"/);
    184 +      if (match && match[1]) {
    185 +        // Unescape styling (newlines, etc)
    186 +        return match[1].replace(/\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\"/g, '"');
    187 +      }
    188 +    }
    189 +    return text;
    190 +  }
    191 +
    192 +  downloadHTML(blob, filename = 'exported-markdown.html') {
    193 +    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    194 +    const a = document.createElement('a');
    195 +    a.href = url;
    196 +    a.download = filename;
    197 +    a.click();
    198 +    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    199 +  }

      4 + * Handles all Mermaid diagram rendering with theme-aware configuration.
      5 + * Automatically detects light/dark themes and adjusts for optimal readability.

     15 +  bgSecondary: '#f5f5f5',
     16 +  bgTertiary: '#e8e8e8',
     17 +  textPrimary: '#1a1a2e',
     18 +  textSecondary: '#666666',
     19 +  h1: '#0969da',
     20 +  h2: '#8250df',
     21 +  h3: '#1a7f37',

     23 +
     24 +/**
     25 + * Calculate relative luminance of a color
     26 + * Used to detect if theme is light or dark
     27 + *
     28 + * @param {string} color - Hex color (#rrggbb)
     29 + * @returns {number} Luminance value (0-1)
     30 + * @private
     31 + */
     32 +function getRelativeLuminance(color) {
     33 +  // Handle empty or invalid colors - default to light theme
     34 +  if (!color || typeof color !== 'string' || color.trim() === '') {
     35 +    return 0.9; // Light theme default
     36 +  }
     37 +
     38 +  // Remove # if present
     39 +  const hex = color.replace('#', '');
     40 +
     41 +  // Validate hex format
     42 +  if (!/^[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(hex)) {
     43 +    return 0.9; // Light theme default for invalid hex
     44 +  }
     45 +
     46 +  // Convert to RGB
     47 +  const r = parseInt(hex.substr(0, 2), 16) / 255;
     48 +  const g = parseInt(hex.substr(2, 2), 16) / 255;
     49 +  const b = parseInt(hex.substr(4, 2), 16) / 255;
     50 +
     51 +  // Apply sRGB gamma correction
     52 +  const rsRGB = r <= 0.03928 ? r / 12.92 : ((r + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
     53 +  const gsRGB = g <= 0.03928 ? g / 12.92 : ((g + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
     54 +  const bsRGB = b <= 0.03928 ? b / 12.92 : ((b + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
     55 +
     56 +  // Calculate relative luminance
     57 +  return 0.2126 * rsRGB + 0.7152 * gsRGB + 0.0722 * bsRGB;
     58 +}
     59 +
     60 +/**
     61 + * Detect if current theme is light or dark
     62 + *
     63 + * @param {string} bgColor - Background color

     65 + * @private

     67 +function isLightTheme(bgColor) {
     68 +  const luminance = getRelativeLuminance(bgColor);

     70 +}
     71 +
     72 +/**
     73 + * Wait for CSS to be fully loaded

     75 + *

     79 +function waitForCSS() {

     31 +  sanitizeColorForSafari(color) {
     32 +    if (!color || typeof color !== 'string') {
     33 +      return '#ffffff'; // Fallback to white
     34 +    }
     35 +
     36 +    color = color.trim();
     37 +
     38 +    // Already a hex color
     39 +    if (color.startsWith('#')) {
     40 +      // Ensure 6-digit hex
     41 +      if (color.length === 4) {
     42 +        return `#${color[1]}${color[1]}${color[2]}${color[2]}${color[3]}${color[3]}`;
     43 +      }
     44 +      return color;
     45 +    }
     46 +
     47 +    // Handle rgba/rgb
     48 +    const rgbaMatch = color.match(/rgba?\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*(?:,\s*[\d.]+)?\s*\)/i);
     49 +    if (rgbaMatch) {
     50 +      const r = parseInt(rgbaMatch[1], 10);
     51 +      const g = parseInt(rgbaMatch[2], 10);
     52 +      const b = parseInt(rgbaMatch[3], 10);
     53 +      return `#${((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1)}`;
     54 +    }
     55 +
     56 +    // Handle named colors by creating a temporary element
     57 +    try {
     58 +      const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
     59 +      tempDiv.style.color = color;
     60 +      document.body.appendChild(tempDiv);
     61 +      const computed = getComputedStyle(tempDiv).color;
     62 +      document.body.removeChild(tempDiv);
     63 +
     64 +      const match = computed.match(/rgba?\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)/i);
     65 +      if (match) {
     66 +        const r = parseInt(match[1], 10);

     69 +        return `#${((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1)}`;
     70 +      }
     71 +    } catch {
     72 +      console.warn('Color conversion failed for:', color);
     73 +    }
     74 +
     75 +    // Fallback
     76 +    return '#ffffff';

    227 +  buildHtml2PdfConfig(config) {
    228 +    const pageSize = config.pageSize || 'A4';
    229 +    const orientation = config.orientation || PDF_CONFIG.ORIENTATIONS.PORTRAIT;
    230 +
    231 +    // Ensure margins are numbers and safe
    232 +    // But we use 0 margin for html2pdf ensuring full background coverage
    233 +    // Margins are handled via padding in prepareContent
    234 +
    235 +    return {
    236 +      margin: 0, // Zero margin for full bleed background
    237 +      filename: config.filename || 'markdown-export.pdf',
    238 +      image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
    239 +      html2canvas: {
    240 +        scale: 2,
    241 +        useCORS: true,
    242 +        letterRendering: true,
    243 +        // Use safe hex color for Safari compatibility
    244 +        backgroundColor: this.getSafeColor('--bg-primary'),
    245 +      },
    246 +      jsPDF: {
    247 +        unit: 'in',
    248 +        format: pageSize.toLowerCase(),
    249 +        orientation,
    250 +      },
    251 +      pagebreak: { mode: ['avoid-all', 'css', 'legacy'] },
    252 +    };
    253 +  }
    254 +
    255 +  /**
    256 +   * Generate PDF and return as blob
    257 +   *
    258 +   * @param {HTMLElement} contentElement - Content element to export
    259 +   * @param {Object} config - PDF configuration
    260 +   * @returns {Promise<Blob>} PDF blob
    261 +   * @throws {Error} If html2pdf not loaded or generation fails
    262 +   *
    263 +   * @example
    264 +   * const blob = await pdfService.generatePDF(previewElement, config);
    265 +   */
    266 +  async generatePDF(contentElement, config = {}) {
    267 +    if (!this.isReady()) {
    268 +      throw new Error('html2pdf library not loaded');
    269 +    }
    270 +
    271 +    // Merge with defaults and validate
    272 +    const mergedConfig = { ...this.getDefaultConfig(), ...config };
    273 +    if (!this.validateConfig(mergedConfig)) {
    274 +      throw new Error('Invalid PDF configuration');
    275 +    }
    276 +
    277 +    try {
    278 +      // Sanitize margins for internal use (Padding)
    279 +      let margins = mergedConfig.margins || PDF_CONFIG.DEFAULT_MARGINS;
    280 +      if (Array.isArray(margins)) {
    281 +        margins = margins.map(m => {
    282 +          const val = parseFloat(m);
    283 +          return isFinite(val) ? val : 0.5; // Default to 0.5 if invalid
    284 +        });
    285 +      } else {
    286 +        margins = PDF_CONFIG.DEFAULT_MARGINS; // Fallback if margins is not an array
    287 +      }
    288 +
    289 +      // Prepare content with isolated styles and margins as padding
    290 +      const container = this.prepareContent(contentElement, mergedConfig, mergedConfig.themeName, mergedConfig.customTheme, margins);
    291 +
    292 +      // Build html2pdf config
    293 +      const pdfConfig = this.buildHtml2PdfConfig(mergedConfig);
    294 +
    295 +      // Generate PDF blob
    296 +      const pdf = html2pdf().set(pdfConfig).from(container);
    297 +      const blob = await pdf.outputPdf('blob');
    298 +
    299 +      // Store for potential download
    300 +      this.currentBlob = blob;
    301 +      this.currentConfig = mergedConfig;
    302 +
    303 +      return blob;
    304 +    } catch (error) {
    305 +      console.error('PDF generation error:', error);
    306 +      throw new Error(`Failed to generate PDF: ${error.message}`);
    307 +    }
    308 +  }
    309 +
    310 +  /**
    311 +   * Generate PDF preview URL
    312 +   *
    313 +   * @param {HTMLElement} content - Content to preview
    314 +   * @param {Object} config - PDF configuration
    315 +   * @returns {Promise<string>} Blob URL for preview
    316 +   * @throws {Error} If generation fails
    317 +   *
    318 +   * @example
    319 +   * const previewUrl = await pdfService.previewPDF(previewElement, config);
    320 +   * iframe.src = previewUrl;
    321 +   */
    322 +  async previewPDF(content, config = {}) {
    323 +    const blob = await this.generatePDF(content, config);
    324 +    return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    325 +  }
    326 +
    327 +  /**
    328 +   * Download previously generated PDF
    329 +   *
    330 +   * @param {string} filename - Optional custom filename
    331 +   * @returns {boolean} True if download initiated
    332 +   *
    333 +   * @example
    334 +   * pdfService.downloadPDF('my-document.pdf');
    335 +   */
    336 +  downloadPDF(filename) {
    337 +    if (!this.currentBlob) {
    338 +      console.error('No PDF generated yet');
    339 +      return false;
    340 +    }
    341 +
    342 +    try {
    343 +      const url = URL.createObjectURL(this.currentBlob);
    344 +      const a = document.createElement('a');
    345 +      a.href = url;
    346 +      a.download = filename || this.currentConfig.filename;
    347 +      a.click();
    348 +      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    349 +      return true;
    350 +    } catch (error) {
    351 +      console.error('PDF download error:', error);
    352 +      return false;
    353 +    }
    354 +  }
    355 +
    356 +  /**
    357 +   * Get current PDF configuration
    358 +   *
    359 +   * @returns {Object} Current configuration
    360 +   */
    361 +  getCurrentConfig() {
    362 +    return { ...this.currentConfig };
    363 +  }
    364 +
    365 +  /**
    366 +   * Update configuration
    367 +   *
    368 +   * @param {Object} config - New configuration values
    369 +   * @returns {boolean} True if update successful
    370 +   *
    371 +   * @example
    372 +   * pdfService.updateConfig({ fontSize: 14, orientation: 'landscape' });
    373 +   */
    374 +  updateConfig(config) {
    375 +    if (!this.validateConfig(config)) {
    376 +      return false;
    377 +    }
    378 +
    379 +    this.currentConfig = { ...this.currentConfig, ...config };
    380 +    return true;
    381 +  }
    382 +
    383 +  /**
    384 +   * Reset to default configuration
    385 +   *
    386 +   * @returns {Object} Default configuration
    387 +   */
    388 +  resetConfig() {
    389 +    this.currentConfig = this.getDefaultConfig();
    390 +    return this.getCurrentConfig();
    391 +  }
    392 +
    393 +  /**
    394 +   * Get available page sizes
    395 +   *
    396 +   * @returns {string[]} Array of page size names
    397 +   */
    398 +  getAvailablePageSizes() {
    399 +    return Object.keys(PDF_CONFIG.PAGE_SIZES);
    400 +  }
    401 +
    402 +  /**
    403 +   * Get available orientations
    404 +   *
    405 +   * @returns {string[]} Array of orientation values
    406 +   */
    407 +  getAvailableOrientations() {
    408 +    return Object.values(PDF_CONFIG.ORIENTATIONS);
    409 +  }
    410 +}
    411
